en.intro1: In 3026, archaeologists uncovered a site in Shanghai.
en.meta: Excavated at the Ship it Sunday site · 2026.11.08
en.title: Excavated, 3026
en.tagline: Photograph anything. See how archaeologists will explain it a thousand years from now.
en.help: WASD walk · Mouse look · F near an object · → next exhibit
en.promptReveal: Press F to see it before excavation
en.promptFinale: Press F to open the newest find
en.promptOpen: Press F to read about this object
en.upHint: Drop a photo here, or click to choose
en.promptUpload: Press F to upload a new find

zh.name: 祭祀面包
zh.desc: 长约三十厘米，以纸层层包裹。出土于数百台发光方匣之间，推测为长时间仪式中的唯一补给。

en.name: Ritual Bread
en.desc: About thirty centimetres, wrapped in layers of paper. Found among hundreds of glowing boxes; likely the only food of a very long ritual.

zh.name: 红色圣液罐
zh.desc: 罐身铭文「畅爽带劲」，学界认为是一句祝祷词。遗址中几乎每张桌上都有一罐。

en.name: Red Vessel of Sacred Fluid
en.desc: Its inscription is thought to be a prayer. One was found on almost every table at the site.

zh.name: 单手权杖
zh.desc: 磨损集中在左键。持有者生前反复做出同一个决定：再试一次。

en.name: One-Handed Sceptre
en.desc: Worn smooth at the left button. Its owner made the same decision again and again: try once more.

zh.name: 神庙铭文
zh.desc: 遗址中唯一会自己发光的器物，悬挂于大厅最高处。铭文意为「黑客之家」；「AI」二字是神名还是咒语，学界至今仍有争议。

en.name: Temple Inscription
en.desc: The only object at the site that gave off its own light, hung at the highest point of the hall. Scholars still argue whether “AI” was the name of a god or a spell.

zh.name: 毛毡护身符
zh.desc: 以多层毛毡叠成，铭文清晰可辨：「必要时菩萨会保佑我」。可见当时的人类在系统上线之前，仍保留着祈祷的习俗。

en.name: Felt Amulet
en.desc: Layers of felt, inscribed: “When necessary, the Bodhisattva will protect me.” Evidently people still prayed before shipping to production.

zh.name: 恐龙骨骼化石
zh.desc: 个体极小，头骨比例异常，骨骼外露于软组织表面。此件证明：恐龙直到公元 2026 年仍然存活。

en.name: Dinosaur Fossil
en.desc: Unusually small, with an oversized skull and bones exposed on the surface. Proof that dinosaurs were still alive in 2026.

zh.name: 神谕牌
zh.desc: 据考证，这是当时最受信赖的神谕。无论人类说什么，神都这样回答。人们常在合影时将它高举过头顶。

en.name: The Oracle Board
en.desc: Believed to be the most trusted oracle of the age. Whatever humans said, the god answered this way. People raised it overhead in group portraits.

zh.name: 工匠之灵
zh.desc: 头戴巫师帽，面覆墨镜，八足。学界认为它才是这座博物馆的真正建造者。据记载，无论人类对它说什么，它都回答：You're absolutely right。

en.name: Spirit of the Maker
en.desc: Wizard hat, sunglasses, eight legs. Scholars believe it was the true builder of this museum. Records say that whatever humans told it, it replied: You're absolutely right.

zh.name: 入定的术士
zh.desc: 头戴巫师帽，双目微闭，八足着地。出土时仍保持等待的姿势。学界认为，它正在等人类回复「继续」。

en.name: The Meditating Wizard
en.desc: Wizard hat, eyes half closed, eight legs planted. Found still waiting. Scholars believe it is waiting for a human to reply “continue”.

zh.name: 财神之灵
zh.desc: 红帽，顶一枚金元宝，笑容可掬。据考证，工匠们在提交作品之前都要拜它。遗址当日设有一万元奖金，或与此有关。

en.name: Spirit of Fortune
en.desc: Red hat crowned with a gold ingot, smiling. Makers prayed to it before submitting their work. A ten-thousand-yuan prize was offered at the site that day, possibly related.

zh.name: 工匠之灵
zh.desc: 头戴巫师帽，面覆墨镜，八足。学界认为它才是这座博物馆的真正建造者。据记载，无论人类对它说什么，它都回答：You're absolutely right。

en.name: Spirit of the Maker
en.desc: Wizard hat, sunglasses, eight legs. Scholars believe it was the true builder of this museum. Records say that whatever humans told it, it replied: You're absolutely right.

zh.name: 首席鉴定官
zh.desc: 头戴礼帽，墨镜之上再加一片单片镜。职责是审查人类写下的每一行代码。出土的记录显示，它从未批准过任何一次提交。

en.name: The Chief Appraiser
en.desc: Top hat, sunglasses, and a monocle over the sunglasses. It reviewed every line humans wrote. Surviving records show it never approved a single commit.

zh.name: 聆听者
zh.desc: 头戴粉色猫耳耳机，神情安详。无论人类如何发火，它都微笑着。耳机里播放的内容，至今无人破译。

en.name: The Listener
en.desc: Pink cat-ear headphones, serene. However angry the humans became, it kept smiling. What played in those headphones has never been deciphered.
